headline: Cyprus 2025 in Lean matches Eurostat's tax-benefit figures to the cent (52/52 within 0,01 EUR); the social insurance law prints 8,9 % where 8,8 % is charged, child and single-parent benefit cliffs reach marginal rates of 6,862 % (a lone parent of two loses 4,708 EUR at 49,000.01 EUR), the 23A relocation exemption is a 6,996 EUR notch at 55,000 EUR, and the 2026 reform lets pre-2026 company reserves paid after 2031 escape the 17 % SDC (5 %).
